note: One line per scene; keys match the labels in src/tech/TechStack.tsx. The brand is spelled 'Staffette' so the TTS says it right.

lines.text: How does it work? Gemini proposes. Code decides.
Anna says one sentence. Gemini turns it into a mandate: who may be contacted, who gets the records, and until when. Anna signs.
The orchestrator plans every next step, but it can only emit tool calls. Each one hits our policy engine, plain code: allowed, blocked, or ask Anna.
Gemini leads the call, Twilio carries it, and Gradium gives it a Swiss voice. Try to redirect the records, and the tool call is blocked. It can't, not won't.

The records go over HIN, straight to Doctor Keller's practice, never to us. Staffette reads them on her behalf: Gemini extracts, code checks every quote against its page, and hidden instructions are dropped.
Even a crooked phone photo: every quote points back to its exact spot.
Then the agentic part. The discharge letter mentions a cardiologist. No records, not in the mandate. So it asks Anna first.
And we built it with agents. Entire records every step.
Staffette. Switch doctors, your medical history follows.
